When showing photos of the game, write the commit and date inside each image, put builds side by side in one sheet, and
take a shot only after the view is drawn (look plan step `{"until": "render_pending", "equals": 0}` before each `shot`).

**Why:** on 2026-11-10 I showed photos of two builds in sequence with no label and the owner took today's photo (blue
glass towers) for the 7 November one, which nearly sent the choice of base the wrong way. Earlier the same day I judged
"no streets from above" from shots taken with 1,691 units still pending. The owner also asked whether I had actually
looked at the city from above before measuring it: I had verified by counts only.

**How to apply:** before measuring or judging a city, photograph it (from above, mid, street level) and look. Verify the
map by picture, not only by counts. When the owner names a direction to look ("before day 07"), go that way first; I went
to the day after and had to be told twice. See [[tree-back-to-nov7]].
